units.english: Forsaking those which are transitory, betake thyself to that which is everlasting, and let contentment be thine, for contentment is the highest of all acquisitions.

units.sanskrit: महा बलान् पश्य महा अनुभावान् प्रशास्य भूमिम् धन धान्य पूर्णाम् राज्यानि हित्वा विपुलान् च भोगान्
units.english: Behold, illustrious and mighty kings, having ruled lands abounding with wealth and corn, have become the victims of the Universal Destroyer, leaving behind their kingdoms and vast sources of enjoyment.

units.sanskrit: मृतम् पुत्रम् दुःख पुष्टम् मनुष्या
units.english: The son brought up with anxious care, when dead, is taken up and carried away by men (to the burning ground).

units.sanskrit: उत्क्षिप्य राजन् स्व गृहात् निर्हरन्ति तम् मुक्त केशाः करुणम् रुदन्तः चिता मध्ये काष्ठम् इव क्षिपन्ति
units.english: With the dishevelled hair and crying piteously, they then cast the body into the funeral pyre, as if it were a piece of wood.

units.sanskrit: अन्यः धनम् प्रेत गतस्य भुङ्क्ते वयांसि च अग्निः च शरीर धातून्
units.english: Others enjoy the deceased's wealth, while birds and fire feast on the elements of his body.

units.sanskrit: द्वाभ्याम् अयम् सह गच्छति अमुत्र पुण्येन पापेन च वेष्ट्यमानः
units.english: With two only he goeth to the other world, viz., his merits and his sins which keep him company.

units.sanskrit: उत्सृज्य विनिवर्तन्ते ज्ञातयः सुहृदः सुताः अपुष्पान् अफलान् वृक्षान् यथा तात पतत्रिणः
units.english: Throwing away the body, O sire, relatives, friends, and sons retrace their steps, like birds abandoning trees without blossoms and fruits.

units.sanskrit: अग्नौ प्रास्तम् तु पुरुषम् कर्म अन्वेति स्वयंकृतम्
units.english: The person cast into the funeral pyre is followed only by his own acts.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् तु पुरुषः यत्नात् धर्मम् संचिनुयात् शनैस्
units.english: Therefore, should men carefully and gradually earn the merit of righteousness.

units.sanskrit: अस्मात् लोकात् ऊर्ध्वम् अमुष्य च अधो महत् तमः तिष्ठति हि अन्धकारम्
units.english: In the world above this, and also in that below this, there are regions of great gloom and darkness.

units.sanskrit: तत् वै महा मोहनम् इन्द्रियाणाम्
units.english: Know, O king, that those are regions where the senses of men are exceedingly afflicted.

units.sanskrit: बुध्यस्व मा त्वाम् प्रलभेत राजन्
units.english: Oh, let not any of those places to thine.

units.sanskrit: निशम्य सर्वम् प्रतिपत्तुम् एवम् यशः परम् प्राप्स्यसि जीव लोके भयम् न च अमुत्र न च इह ते अस्ति
units.english: Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter.

units.sanskrit: आत्मा नदी भारत पुण्य तीर्था
units.english: O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river; religious merit constitutes its sacred baths;

units.sanskrit: सत्य उदका धृति कूला दम ऊर्मिः
units.english: truth, its water; self-control, its banks; kindness, its waves.

units.sanskrit: तस्याम् स्नातः पूयते पुण्य कर्मा पुण्यः हि आत्मा नित्यम् अम्भः अम्भः एव
units.english: He that is righteous purifieth himself by a bath therein, for the soul is sacred, and the absence of desire is the highest merit.

units.sanskrit: काम क्रोध ग्राहवतीम् पञ्च इन्द्रिय जलाम् नदीम् कृत्वा धृति मयीम् नावम् जन्म दुर्गाणि संतर
units.english: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger.

units.sanskrit: प्रज्ञा वृद्धम् धर्म वृद्धम् स्व बन्धुम् विद्या वृद्धम् वयसा च अपि वृद्धम् कार्य अकार्ये पूजयित्वा प्रसाद्य
units.english: Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue, learning, and years, he that asketh their advice about what he should do and should not do, is never misled.

units.sanskrit: धृत्या शिश्न उदरम् रक्षेत् पाणि पादम् च चक्षुषा
units.english: One should restrain one's lust and stomach by patience; one's hands and feet by one's eyes;

units.sanskrit: चक्षुः श्रोत्रे च मनसा मनः वाचम् च कर्मणा
units.english: one's eyes and ears by one's mind; and one's mind and words by one's acts.

units.sanskrit: नित्य स्वाध्यायी पतित अन्न वर्जी ऋतम् ब्रुवन् गुरवे कर्म कुर्वन् न ब्राह्मणः च्यवते ब्रह्म लोकात्
units.english: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor, never falleth off from the region of Brahma.

units.sanskrit: इष्ट्वा यज्ञैः पालयित्वा प्रजाः च गो ब्राह्मण अर्थे शस्त्र पूत अन्तरात्मा हतः संग्रामे क्षत्रियः स्वर्गम् एति
units.english: Having studied the Vedas, poured libations into fire, performed sacrifices, protected subjects, sanctified his soul by drawing weapons for protecting kine and Brahmanas, and died on the field of battle, the Kshatriya attaineth to heaven.

units.sanskrit: वैश्यः अधीत्य ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् च धनैः काले संविभज्य आश्रितान् च त्रेता पूतम् धूमम् आघ्राय पुण्यम्
units.english: Having studied the Vedas, and distributed in proper time, his wealth among Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and his own dependents, and inhaled the sanctified smoke of the three kinds of fires, the Vaisya enjoyeth heavenly bliss in the other world.

units.sanskrit: प्रेत्य स्वर्गे देव सुखानि भुङ्क्ते ब्रह्म क्षत्रम् वैश्य वर्णम् च शूद्रः क्रमेण एतान् न्यायतः पूजयानः
units.english: Having properly worshipped Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaisayas in due order, and having burnt his sins, by gratifying them, and then peacefully casting off his body, the Sudra enjoyeth the bliss of heaven.

units.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य एष धर्मः तव उक्तः
units.english: The duties of the four orders are thus set forth before thee.

units.sanskrit: हेतुम् च अत्र ब्रुवतः मे निबोध
units.english: Listen now to the reason of my speech as I discourse it.

units.sanskrit: क्षात्रात् धर्मात् धीयते पाण्डु पुत्रः
units.english: Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, is falling off from the duties of the Kshatriya order.

units.sanskrit: तम् त्वम् राजन् राज धर्मे नियुङ्क्ष्व धृतराष्ट्रः उवाच एवम् एतत् यथा माम् त्वम् अनुशाससि नित्यदा
units.english: Place him, therefore, O king, in a position to discharge the duties of kings.' "Dhritarashtra said, It is even so as thou always teachest me.

units.sanskrit: मम अपि च मतिः सौम्य भवति एवम् यथा आत्थ माम्
units.english: O amiable one, my heart also inclineth that very way of which thou tellest me.

units.sanskrit: सा तु बुद्धिः कृता अपि एवम् पाण्डवान् प्रति मे सदा दुर्योधनम् समासाद्य पुनर् विपरिवर्तते
units.english: Although, however, I incline in my mind towards the Pandavas even as thou teachest me to do, yet as soon as I come in contact with Duryodhana it turneth off in a different way.

units.sanskrit: न दिष्टम् अभ्यतिक्रान्तुम् शक्यम् मर्त्येन केन चित्
units.english: No creature is able to avert fate.

units.sanskrit: दिष्टम् एव कृतम् मन्ये पौरुषम् तु निरर्थकम्
units.english: Indeed, Destiny, I think, is certain to take its course;
